title: Prize Tablet Survey
scenario: A pop-up says students at your school can win a tablet after completing a survey with home address details.

answers.A: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.B: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.C: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: Prize Tablet Survey: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Prizes that ask for private home details are usually data traps.
